name: E4 bottom dock: Property List, Find Results, Diagnostics
description: Phase 1 slice E4. A fixture project gets two 1k resistors and a VIN net label through the engine's execute_command IPC (SETUP). In the real window: the bottom dock's Property List picks both Value cells with the column header and sets 4k7 with one Enter, which the status bar reports as one Batch command; both cells show 4k7, and ONE Edit > Undo puts both back to 1k (one revision, one undo step). Ctrl+F (B3 Find and replace) for R, then List in Find Results lists the two designators in the Find Results tab; a click on R2 selects that one part on the sheet. Diagnostics lists tasks, the performance profile, model connectivity and recovery: the fresh project's clean open is OK, and with no provider ever tested no model row is OK.
